text:
Type: grey linen cushion with tie closure
Use: on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, farmhouse, minimalist
Materials: woven linen-look fabric with a soft slub texture, fabric tie closure, checked lining at the opening
Colors: medium cool grey, beige check detail
Shape: square cushion with a plain front, three small bow ties along the bottom edge showing a peek of check fabric, soft and plump
Feel: relaxed, soft, homey, calm
Goes with: white or natural linen, light wood, grey tones; Scandinavian, farmhouse or cottage rooms

product.name: URSULA
product.description: The cushion cover is made of ramie, a hard-wearing natural material with a slightly irregular texture.
